description: Reviewed cross-optimization behaviour: profiles whose output is compiled at another level than its input. compiler_sensitive: the output behaves exactly like the original source at the output level. cross_level_limit: the output follows the output level's own semantics (O2 inlining reads, builtin folding, FASTCALL arity) where the bytecode cannot tell the source's spelling; exactness is promised at the input's level only. Neither is a semantic pass. Exact source, driver, compiler options and raw/normalized observations must match; new or changed mismatches fail. Re-baselined 2026-10-30 after restoring source spellings and the safeenv import rule on v2.8-dev.
